<thought>To find a suitable retrosynthetic template for a Diels‑Alder reaction that can generate the target bicyclic lactone, I will search the template catalog for reactions that form a new six‑membered ring (bond type 6‑6) and involve a change of a C=C double bond to a single bond (order change). This should retrieve a Diels‑Alder template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
  "bonds_order_changed": ["C=C (2.0->1.0)"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
